root_cause: When a user pasted multi-line markdown at an interactive prompt, the first line was consumed as the answer and the remaining lines buffered in stdin. The main REPL then interpreted each line as a separate command, producing a cascade of unknown-command errors.

details.rule: After every interactive prompt, drain stdin non-blockingly. In the main REPL loop, silently discard lines that match paste-artifact prefixes (leading #, -, >, |, backtick fences, or indentation) before attempting command dispatch.
